question: Why are purchase orders from supplier ACME being delayed?
expected_evidence: PO-ACME-002 is delayed due to temporary production capacity constraints.
PO-ACME-003 is delayed because an additional quality inspection is pending.
PO-ACME-004 is delayed because a critical production component is unavailable.
expected_limitations: The available evidence does not establish a revised delivery date for the delayed orders.
The supplier-level capacity incident does not establish the cause of every delayed purchase order.
